mission.zh: 可溯源的中英双语 3D 网站、工具、引擎与生产流程技术档案
mission.en: Evidence-based bilingual atlas of 3D experiences, tools, engines and production workflows

projects.name: VIPER 11
projects.upstream_license: Proprietary; technical notes only

summary.zh: 浏览器内运行的高拟真战机模拟器，公开十五篇工程制作笔记。
summary.en: A high-fidelity fighter simulator in a browser, accompanied by fifteen engineering notes.

strength.zh: 把真实地形、体积云、摄影镜头、六自由度飞控和声音整合成一致的飞行体验。
strength.en: Combines real terrain, volumetric clouds, camera optics, six-degree-of-freedom flight dynamics and audio into one convincing experience.

learning.zh: 研究时域体积云、四叉树地形 LOD、参数化飞机零件、输入/物理分离；完整游戏源码未确认开放。
learning.en: Study temporal volumetrics, quadtree terrain LOD, parametric aircraft parts and input/physics separation; full game source has not been verified as open.

projects.name: Bruno Simon Folio 2025
projects.upstream_license: MIT (repository; server code excluded)

summary.zh: 把作品集做成可驾驶、可碰撞和可探索的三维游戏。
summary.en: A portfolio transformed into a drivable, collision-enabled, explorable 3D world.

strength.zh: 开源了主循环依赖顺序、物理车辆、天气、音频、素材压缩与 Blender 工程。
strength.en: Shares game-loop dependency order, vehicle physics, weather, audio, asset compression and Blender sources.

learning.zh: 学习输入→固定物理→视觉→渲染的执行顺序，优化模型和纹理交付。
learning.en: Learn input → fixed physics → visuals → render scheduling and optimized model/texture delivery.

projects.name: ORYZO by Lusion
projects.upstream_license: Site proprietary; source not confirmed

summary.zh: 以虚构消费品为主角的电影级交互式 3D 产品网站。
summary.en: A cinematic interactive 3D product experience built around a fictional consumer object.

strength.zh: 用有限的高品质物体、材质与镜头表现替代庞杂的页面堆砌。
strength.en: Uses a tightly art-directed hero object, materials and camera motion instead of a cluttered interface.

learning.zh: 研究产品特写、滚动叙事与光照层次；具体渲染栈待源码证实。
learning.en: Study product close-ups, scroll-directed storytelling and lighting hierarchy; render stack remains unverified.

projects.name: IVRESS — Spin a Tale
projects.upstream_license: Site proprietary; no reuse permission inferred

summary.zh: 面向品牌叙事的高品质三维交互作品。
summary.en: A polished, interactive 3D experience for brand storytelling.

strength.zh: 制作团队公开讨论 Three.js WebGPURenderer 与 TSL 的双渲染后端实践。
strength.en: Its makers discuss Three.js WebGPURenderer and TSL with a WebGL fallback path.

learning.zh: 研究同一节点材质在 WebGPU/WebGL2 之间的验证与降级策略。
learning.en: Study testing and fallback strategy for node materials across WebGPU and WebGL2.

projects.name: Explore Primland
projects.upstream_license: Site proprietary; source not confirmed

summary.zh: 以沉浸式地形与场景漫游展现真实目的地。
summary.en: An immersive geographic and scenic exploration experience.

strength.zh: 把空间导览、景深与镜头节奏用于传达真实地域的氛围。
strength.en: Uses spatial navigation, depth and pacing to convey the atmosphere of a real destination.

learning.zh: 学习大尺度场景的镜头路线、空气透视与分级细节；技术栈未经源码核实。
learning.en: Study camera paths, atmospheric perspective and detail hierarchy in large worlds; stack is not source-verified.

projects.name: Igloo Inc
projects.upstream_license: Site proprietary; source not confirmed

summary.zh: 以冰材质与沉浸式互动塑造独特品牌视觉语言。
summary.en: An immersive brand site shaped around ice-like materials and interaction.

strength.zh: 统一材质主题和精确打光能形成强烈识别度，而不必堆积场景。
strength.en: A coherent material signature and precise lighting create identity without sprawling scenes.

learning.zh: 研究折射、粗糙度和环境反射的统一美术规范；内部 Shader 未验证。
learning.en: Study cohesive refraction, roughness and environmental reflection; internal shaders remain unverified.

projects.name: Lacoste Ace Breaker
projects.upstream_license: Brand experience; source not public

summary.zh: 把品牌宣传转化成可操作的网页小游戏体验。
summary.en: Turns a brand campaign into a playable browser mini-game.

strength.zh: 短操作反馈和明确的交互目标比纯粹被动观看更容易建立参与感。
strength.en: Short feedback loops and clear player goals create participation beyond passive viewing.

learning.zh: 研究从进入、控制提示到核心玩法和分享的首分钟体验；不复制商标/美术。
learning.en: Study onboarding, input hints, the first-minute core loop and sharing; do not copy branding or artwork.

projects.name: Shopify Editions
projects.upstream_license: Commercial website; no license to copy

summary.zh: 用滚动章节和动效介绍大型产品版本更新。
summary.en: Uses scroll-driven chapters and motion to explain a major product release.

strength.zh: 在视觉叙事之外保留内容层级和可阅读文字，而不是让 3D 吞没信息。
strength.en: Preserves readable information architecture alongside visual motion instead of letting 3D overwhelm content.

learning.zh: 研究滚动时间线、性能降级和语义化页面的共存。
learning.en: Study scroll timelines, progressive enhancement and semantic content preservation.

projects.name: NASA Eyes
projects.upstream_license: US government data/site terms vary by asset; verify individually

summary.zh: 由科学数据驱动的太阳系、地球和航天任务交互式三维可视化。
summary.en: Interactive 3D visualizations of the solar system, Earth and missions driven by scientific data.

strength.zh: 真实信息与可探索空间结合，证明 3D 也可以是严肃的工具。
strength.en: Links authentic information to explorable space, showing that 3D can be a serious utility.

learning.zh: 学习分层数据、时间轴、轨道可视化与用户易读性；图像/数据授权逐项核查。
learning.en: Study layered data, time controls, orbit visuals and legibility; review data/image rights per source.

projects.name: Laarpi 3D Examples
projects.upstream_license: Examples are proprietary unless separately licensed

summary.zh: 展示参数化 3D 商品展示与工程表达的组合思路。
summary.en: Examples of combining parametric 3D products with technical presentation.

strength.zh: 让尺寸、二维规格与三维模型依赖同一个参数源，减少不一致。
strength.en: A shared parametric source can drive dimensions, 2D specification views and 3D models.

learning.zh: 学习参数映射与尺寸驱动的可靠交互；案例具体技术须单独验证。
learning.en: Learn parameter mapping and dimension-driven interaction; verify each case's technical implementation.

projects.name: AnyScene
projects.upstream_license: MIT code; generated models/service terms separate

summary.zh: 从参考图或文字 Brief 构建可重建的 Blender 场景、道具、灯光和镜头。
summary.en: Builds reproducible Blender scenes, props, lights and shots from references or a written brief.

strength.zh: 同一物件让两个生成器竞争，用同光照对比选优，再做几何接触和视觉纠错。
strength.en: Competes two 3D generators per prop, compares like-for-like renders, then checks contact and visual defects.

learning.zh: 学习资产清单、来源记录、脚本可重建场景、独立质量审查与 GPU 排队。
learning.en: Learn asset manifests, provenance, scripted rebuilds, independent visual critique and GPU queues.

projects.name: AnyKit
projects.upstream_license: MIT code; generated assets separate

summary.zh: 从风格参考生成同一美术语言的游戏道具套件。
summary.en: Creates cohesive production-oriented 3D prop kits from style references.

strength.zh: 逐件校准真实米制尺寸、朝向、原点、玻璃材质和 LOD，输出独立 GLB 与整套资产库。
strength.en: Normalizes real-world meters, orientation, origin, glass and LOD per prop; exports individual GLBs and a shared library.

learning.zh: 重点研究 normalize.py、模型对照、独立 critic 与可续跑的幂等请求。
learning.en: Prioritize normalize.py, model comparisons, independent critique and resumable idempotent jobs.

projects.name: AnyShot
projects.upstream_license: MIT code; cloud compute billed separately

summary.zh: 根据场景与自然语言自动规划摄影机、预览镜头并生成最终影像。
summary.en: Plans cameras from a 3D scene and language brief, previews shots and delivers graded imagery.

strength.zh: 镜头逐帧防穿模，先低成本预览再渲染，支持云端分片、缓存及恢复。
strength.en: Checks camera clearance frame by frame, blocks cheaply before final renders, and supports chunked rendering and resume.

learning.zh: 学习机位规划、镜头路径、深度焦点、异步帧块调度和可恢复任务。
learning.en: Learn shot planning, camera paths, rack focus, asynchronous frame chunks and retry safety.

projects.name: Video-to-Game
projects.upstream_license: MIT (repository; upstream asset rights separate)

summary.zh: 以原创视觉参考视频指导 Three.js 游戏制作和效果验收。
summary.en: Uses original reference videos to guide Three.js game creation and visual verification.

strength.zh: 把镜头/色彩/资产明确化，再通过并排画面对照和实际键盘试玩验证可玩性。
strength.en: Formalizes camera, palette and assets, then checks side-by-side images and actual keyboard play.

learning.zh: 学习视频到 SPEC 的转译、固定机位画面对比与操控测试。
learning.en: Learn video-to-SPEC translation, locked-camera visual comparisons and input-driven tests.

projects.name: AssetFurnace
projects.upstream_license: Apache-2.0 project; model weights/licensing separate

summary.zh: 面向图像转 3D 的工作台，组织多种生成后端和资产处理流程。
summary.en: An image-to-3D workbench orchestrating several generation backends and asset processing steps.

strength.zh: 将生成、缩面、纹理处理、Rig 和质量比较纳入可重复管线。
strength.en: Connects generation, decimation, texture processing, rigging and comparisons in a repeatable pipeline.

learning.zh: 先审显存、模型权重和第三方授权，再在小样本上验收实际 GLB。
learning.en: Audit VRAM, model weights and third-party rights, then validate real GLBs on a small sample.

projects.name: TRELLIS.2
projects.upstream_license: Repository MIT; dependencies/checkpoints require review

summary.zh: 研究级图像转高质量三维资产模型，强调高保真几何与材质表达。
summary.en: A research-grade image-to-3D model emphasizing high-fidelity geometry and materials.

strength.zh: 提供高质量资产生成的技术基准，但算力门槛可能显著高于日常显卡预算。
strength.en: Offers a quality benchmark for asset synthesis while demanding substantial compute.

learning.zh: 参考官方硬件门槛，不把 16GB 显卡视为已经验证可稳定跑通。
learning.en: Respect documented hardware requirements; do not treat 16 GB GPUs as validated.

projects.name: World Labs Marble
projects.upstream_license: Proprietary cloud service; terms required

summary.zh: 把文本、图片或视频转换为可探索的三维场景表示。
summary.en: Turns text, images or video into explorable 3D scene representations.

strength.zh: 强调持久空间、可视化资产与独立碰撞网格的组合。
strength.en: Emphasizes persistent space and the pairing of visual assets with separate collision geometry.

learning.zh: 研究视觉层与物理层分离、成本、输出权属及场景质量稳定性。
learning.en: Study visual/physics separation, cost, output rights and scene consistency.

projects.name: Spark 3DGS
projects.upstream_license: Check current upstream LICENSE

summary.zh: 面向 Three.js 的浏览器高斯泼溅渲染库。
summary.en: A browser Gaussian-splat rendering library for Three.js.

strength.zh: 可以把复杂扫描场景作为视觉层接入 Web 3D，再配合独立 Collider。
strength.en: Renders dense scanned spaces as a visual layer in Web3D while physics uses separate colliders.

learning.zh: 学习 3DGS 与 Mesh 共场景的遮挡、深度、排序和性能权衡。
learning.en: Study occlusion, depth, sorting and performance when mixing 3DGS with meshes.

projects.name: Three.js
projects.upstream_license: MIT

summary.zh: 浏览器 3D 图形的核心开源 JavaScript 库。
summary.en: A foundational open-source JavaScript library for 3D graphics in the browser.

strength.zh: 场景图、相机、材质、动画和现代 WebGPU/TSL 路径都拥有成熟生态。
strength.en: Combines a mature scene graph, cameras, materials, animation and a modern WebGPU/TSL direction.

learning.zh: 理解渲染循环、资源缓存、LOD、Instancing、WebGL2 与 WebGPU 差异。
learning.en: Understand render loops, caches, LOD, instancing and WebGL2/WebGPU tradeoffs.

projects.name: A-Frame
projects.upstream_license: MIT (verify current repository)

summary.zh: 建立在 Three.js 上、用 HTML 和实体组件系统制作 WebXR/VR 场景的框架。
summary.en: An HTML-first, entity-component framework for WebXR/VR scenes built on Three.js.

strength.zh: 使用声明式组件降低 VR 场景开发门槛，同时保留 Three.js 扩展能力。
strength.en: Makes immersive scenes approachable through declarative components while preserving Three.js extensibility.

learning.zh: 学习 ECS、组件复用、XR 输入映射与渐进式交互。
learning.en: Study ECS, component reuse, XR input mapping and progressive interaction.

projects.name: Babylon.js
projects.upstream_license: Apache-2.0 (engine repository)

summary.zh: 涵盖渲染、材质、动画、物理集成与编辑器生态的 Web 3D 引擎。
summary.en: A Web 3D engine covering rendering, materials, animation, physics integration and tooling.

strength.zh: 具有更完整的引擎式 API 与可视化调试工具，适合大型应用原型。
strength.en: Provides an engine-style API and rich debugging tools suited to larger applications.

learning.zh: 对照 Three.js 的场景管理与 Shader 工具链，评估跨引擎资产格式。
learning.en: Compare scene management and shader tooling with Three.js and assess cross-engine assets.

projects.name: PlayCanvas
projects.upstream_license: MIT (engine; editor/cloud terms separate)

summary.zh: 专为 Web 实时交互设计的引擎，提供组件化运行时与可视化制作平台。
summary.en: A web-first real-time engine with a component runtime and visual production tooling.

strength.zh: 适合交互式商品、轻量游戏和多人协作式场景迭代。
strength.en: Suited to interactive products, lightweight games and collaborative scene iteration.

learning.zh: 学习分包加载、组件架构、压缩与浏览器端性能预算。
learning.en: Study chunked loading, component architecture, compression and web performance budgets.

projects.name: React Three Fiber
projects.upstream_license: MIT

summary.zh: 用 React 声明式组件组织 Three.js 场景。
summary.en: A React reconciler for declaratively building Three.js scenes.

strength.zh: 使 3D 场景与普通网站状态、路由和 UI 工作流更自然结合。
strength.en: Integrates 3D scenes with conventional website state, routing and UI workflows.

learning.zh: 研究组件化游戏场景与帧循环；v10.0.0-alpha.6 默认采用可回退 WebGL2 的新 WebGPURenderer，但旧 GLSL 需评估 /legacy，Alpha 不可直接视为生产稳定版。
learning.en: Study composable game scenes and frame scheduling; v10.0.0-alpha.6 defaults to a WebGL2-capable WebGPURenderer but legacy GLSL may need /legacy; alpha is not a stable production baseline.

projects.name: Blender
projects.upstream_license: GPL-2.0-or-later (software; review linked assets)

summary.zh: 开放源码的建模、雕刻、绑定、动画、材质与渲染综合 DCC。
summary.en: An open-source DCC suite for modeling, sculpting, rigging, animation, shading and rendering.

strength.zh: Python 脚本与背景模式可把人工制作步骤转成可复现的生产流水线。
strength.en: Python automation and headless mode turn artistic operations into reproducible pipelines.

learning.zh: 研究资产标准化、批量处理、Rig 骨骼约束、Cycles 输出与脚本重建。
learning.en: Study asset normalization, batch processing, rig constraints, Cycles output and scripted rebuilds.

projects.name: Godot
projects.upstream_license: MIT

summary.zh: 跨平台的开源 2D/3D 游戏引擎，提供完整场景节点、动画和物理工作流。
summary.en: An open-source 2D/3D game engine with complete scenes, animation and physics workflows.

strength.zh: 对小团队的快速可玩性验证与非 Web 原生交付具有工程优势。
strength.en: Offers an integrated gameplay workflow for small teams and non-web-native builds.

learning.zh: 研究 GLB 导入、角色动画状态机与 Web 导出限制，不预设 WebGPU 网页可用。
learning.en: Study GLB import, animation state machines and web export limits; do not assume WebGPU web export.

projects.name: Unity
projects.upstream_license: Proprietary commercial engine; terms/fees vary

summary.zh: 面向多平台实时互动、游戏与工业可视化的商业引擎。
summary.en: A commercial engine for multiplatform games, interactive experiences and industrial visualization.

strength.zh: 规模化资产导入、工具生态和可用插件众多，利于项目交付。
strength.en: Broad asset workflows and mature tooling support production delivery.

learning.zh: 研究 GLB/FBX 资产兼容和浏览器交付限制；授权费与条款按项目审核。
learning.en: Review GLB/FBX workflows and browser constraints; verify license terms per project.

projects.name: Unreal Engine
projects.upstream_license: Proprietary/EULA; source access is not open-source

summary.zh: 面向高保真大型三维场景、电影与复杂游戏的商业引擎。
summary.en: A commercial engine for high-fidelity worlds, cinematics and complex games.

strength.zh: Nanite、Lumen 和电影化内容生产为高品质资产标准提供参考。
strength.en: Nanite, Lumen and cinematic pipelines provide a reference for premium asset quality.

learning.zh: 研究资产尺度、PBR 和动作重定向；不能把源码可见等同 OSI 开源。
learning.en: Study asset scale, PBR and animation retargeting; source access does not mean OSI open source.

projects.name: Rapier
projects.upstream_license: Apache-2.0

summary.zh: Rust 实现的高性能刚体、碰撞检测和查询物理库，带 JavaScript/WASM 生态。
summary.en: A high-performance Rust physics library with collision detection, queries and JS/WASM bindings.

strength.zh: 把真实碰撞与视觉 Mesh 分离，有助于消除穿模、滑行和动作错位。
strength.en: Separates collision physics from render meshes, reducing clipping and animation mismatches.

learning.zh: 学习固定步长、碰撞体、角色控制器和可重放测试。
learning.en: Study fixed timesteps, collider design, character control and replay testing.

projects.name: three-geospatial
projects.upstream_license: Check current upstream LICENSE

summary.zh: Three.js 体系的地理空间渲染与大气相关技术集合。
summary.en: A Three.js geospatial rendering and atmospheric technology toolkit.

strength.zh: 能够研究真实地形、天空大气及体积云的分层实现方案。
strength.en: Offers a learning path for terrain, atmospheric sky and cloud-related rendering.

learning.zh: 重点核查各子模块 shader API、许可证与 Three.js 版本兼容。
learning.en: Review per-module shader APIs, license and Three.js compatibility.

projects.name: glTF Transform
projects.upstream_license: MIT

summary.zh: 对 glTF/GLB 进行变换、检查、压缩与优化的工具链。
summary.en: A toolkit for transforming, inspecting, compressing and optimizing glTF/GLB.

strength.zh: 把纹理编码、网格压缩和批处理变成资产发布过程的一部分。
strength.en: Turns texture encoding, geometry compression and batch transforms into a release pipeline.

learning.zh: 建立 GLB 文件大小、材质兼容与视觉误差的自动验收。
learning.en: Build automated checks for GLB size, material compatibility and visual error.

projects.name: meshoptimizer
projects.upstream_license: MIT

summary.zh: 网格拓扑与索引优化、压缩和 LOD 的高性能基础库。
summary.en: A fast library for mesh topology/index optimization, compression and LOD.

strength.zh: 在画质可接受的前提下降低带宽、GPU 顶点处理和模型复杂度。
strength.en: Reduces bandwidth and vertex work while preserving acceptable visual quality.

learning.zh: 研究 gltfpack、Meshopt 解码与按距离动态 LOD。
learning.en: Study gltfpack, Meshopt decoding and distance-based LOD.

projects.name: VGGT
projects.upstream_license: Code and checkpoint licenses differ; commercial weights only where permitted

summary.zh: 从多视图图片恢复摄像机、深度和空间几何关系的视觉模型。
summary.en: A vision model recovering camera poses, depth and geometric structure from multi-view imagery.

strength.zh: 帮助把参考图连接到具有空间尺度的场景重建流程。
strength.en: Helps bridge reference images and spatially grounded scene reconstruction.

learning.zh: 研究镜头标定、COLMAP 数据出口；不可把输出当完整可玩 Mesh 或角色 Rig。
learning.en: Study camera calibration and COLMAP export; outputs are not automatically playable meshes or rigs.

projects.name: prompt2rig
projects.upstream_license: Apache-2.0 repo; SMPL-X/other weights separately restricted

summary.zh: 尝试从文本与动作视频自动生产角色动作并映射骨骼。
summary.en: A research pipeline for generating and retargeting character motion from prompts and video.

strength.zh: 把动作来源和骨骼映射流程模块化，为动画工厂提供候选输入。
strength.en: Modularizes motion sourcing and retargeting for an animation pipeline.

learning.zh: 验证关节方向、IK、手握武器与 Root Motion；不要仅凭视频外观判定动作正确。
learning.en: Test joint axes, IK, weapon grip and root motion rather than accepting a pretty preview.

projects.name: Gua Game QA
projects.upstream_license: Review current upstream LICENSE

summary.zh: 通过结构化游戏状态和可重复操作做游戏自动化测试。
summary.en: Automation tooling using structured game state and reproducible actions.

strength.zh: 将游戏状态、虚拟时间和动作轨迹纳入可验证的质量反馈循环。
strength.en: Makes game state, virtual time and action traces part of a repeatable QA loop.

learning.zh: 借鉴语义操作接口，不能未经验证声称工具直接支持所有 Three.js 游戏。
learning.en: Borrow semantic game testing ideas; do not assume it supports all Three.js games.

projects.name: SuperSplat Editor 3.0
projects.upstream_license: MIT editor; hosted SuperSplat services proprietary

summary.zh: PlayCanvas 开源的浏览器高斯泼溅编辑器，3.0 采用 WebGPU 驱动大规模场景的编辑和可视化。
summary.en: An open-source browser-based Gaussian splat editor whose 3.0 architecture uses WebGPU for large-scale editing.

strength.zh: 作者把高斯投影、视锥剔除、GPU 排序、选择与导出改成 GPU 与流式处理，降低 JS 堆压力。
strength.en: GPU compute projection, culling, sorting, selection and streamed export reduce JavaScript heap pressure.

learning.zh: 重点拆解 3.0 的 GPU radix sort、分块 GPU 存储、选择遮挡与内存基准；不把云端 Studio 误认为开源。
learning.en: Study GPU radix sort, chunked storage, occlusion-aware selection and memory benchmarks; separate open editor from hosted Studio.

projects.name: SuperSplat Viewer
projects.upstream_license: MIT viewer; hosted platform and uploaded content separate

summary.zh: 面向高斯泼溅场景的可自托管静态网页查看器，支持不同高斯资产格式与碰撞数据。
summary.en: A self-hostable static viewer for Gaussian splat scenes, supporting multiple splat formats and optional collision assets.

strength.zh: 官方文档披露 WebGPU 优先、WebGL 回退以及独立碰撞文件入口，兼顾视觉质量与浏览器可用性。
strength.en: The documented WebGPU-first/WebGL-fallback path and separate collision inputs serve both visuals and navigability.

learning.zh: 研究 viewer 的设置文件、碰撞 GLB、海报首屏及不同终端的回退表现。
learning.en: Study viewer settings, collision GLB, loading posters and cross-device fallback behavior.

projects.name: SplatTransform
projects.upstream_license: MIT library/CLI; source scan data separate

summary.zh: 高斯泼溅格式转换和批处理工具，支持 PLY、SOG、SPZ 等格式及流式多层级输出。
summary.en: A CLI and library for converting and batch-processing splats across PLY, SOG, SPZ and other formats.

strength.zh: 将合并、几何变换、筛选、局部性优化、LOD 和碰撞数据生成组织为确定性工具链。
strength.en: Combines transforms, filtering, spatial reordering, merging, LOD and collision outputs in a reproducible pipeline.

learning.zh: 测一组相同场景从 PLY 到 Streamed SOG 的体积、首帧时间与碰撞近似误差。
learning.en: Measure file size, first-frame latency and collision approximation for PLY→Streamed SOG.

projects.name: Google <model-viewer>
projects.upstream_license: Apache-2.0 code; imported model assets separate

summary.zh: 通过 Web Component 将 GLB/glTF 放入网站，并在兼容设备上交接 AR 展示。
summary.en: A Web Component for placing interactive glTF/GLB assets into a page and handing off to AR on supported devices.

strength.zh: 将模型查看、轨道控制和网站布局解耦，另有渲染一致性测试工具。
strength.en: Separates model display from website layout, with companion render-fidelity tooling.

learning.zh: 比较同一套 GLB 在 model-viewer、Three.js 与商品详情页的真实显示与交互差异。
learning.en: Compare the same GLB across model-viewer, custom Three.js and product detail pages.

projects.name: three-mesh-bvh
projects.upstream_license: MIT

summary.zh: 为 Three.js Mesh 构建 BVH 加速结构，显著改善复杂模型上的 Raycast 和空间查询。
summary.en: A BVH acceleration structure for Three.js meshes, speeding up raycasting and spatial queries.

strength.zh: 用层级包围体减少三角形相交测试，适合编辑器选择、场景拾取、局部碰撞和距离查询。
strength.en: Hierarchical bounds prune triangle intersection tests for picking, editing, collision queries and distance checks.

learning.zh: 建立高面数 GLB 上 Raycast 与 BVH 的基准并验证动态 Mesh 更新成本。
learning.en: Benchmark plain raycasts versus BVH against high-poly GLBs and quantify dynamic mesh update costs.

projects.name: pmndrs postprocessing
projects.upstream_license: Check current upstream license; WebGL examples documented

summary.zh: Three.js 的 EffectComposer 后处理库，用 RenderPass 和 EffectPass 组织画面效果。
summary.en: A postprocessing library for Three.js that organizes fullscreen effects as render and effect passes.

strength.zh: 公开说明线性工作流、HDR 半浮点中间缓冲与 Bloom 等效果的正确组合方式。
strength.en: Documents linear color workflow, HDR half-float buffers and composable effects such as bloom.

learning.zh: 核对 SRGB/线性光/HDR 顺序，避免叠加后处理造成带状、过曝和帧率下降。
learning.en: Validate sRGB/linear/HDR order and measure banding, clipping and GPU cost.

projects.name: CesiumJS
projects.upstream_license: Apache-2.0 engine; Cesium ion/data licensing separate

summary.zh: 用于三维地球、全球地形、地理时序和动态数据可视化的浏览器引擎。
summary.en: A browser engine for 3D globes, global terrain, time-dependent geospatial data and visualization.

strength.zh: 开放格式、全球尺度数据管理与可视化更新机制适合大型地形世界的技术对照。
strength.en: Open formats and globe-scale data management provide a reference for huge 3D terrains.

learning.zh: 学习地理坐标、瓦片级别、视域剔除和地理数据授权；不把 ion 订阅当成引擎许可证。
learning.en: Study coordinate systems, tile LOD, visibility and geodata rights; do not conflate ion subscriptions with engine licensing.

projects.name: 3d-tiles-renderer
projects.upstream_license: Check current upstream LICENSE; tile data separately licensed

summary.zh: 将 3D Tiles 分层空间数据带入 Three.js、Babylon.js 和 PlayCanvas 的渲染库。
summary.en: A renderer for 3D Tiles datasets with Three.js, Babylon.js and PlayCanvas integrations.

strength.zh: 按需流式读取大型几何瓦片，帮助现有引擎处理大范围城市、火星及地形数据。
strength.en: Streams tiled geometric data for existing engines, including large city or planetary scenes.

learning.zh: 研究瓦片请求调度、显存与网络预算、几何正确性和不同引擎一致性。
learning.en: Study tile request scheduling, GPU/network budgets, geometry correctness and cross-engine fidelity.

projects.name: @react-three/drei
projects.upstream_license: Check current upstream LICENSE

summary.zh: 面向 React Three Fiber 的常用 3D 控件与现成组件集合。
summary.en: A helper/component library for React Three Fiber applications.

strength.zh: 把轨道控制、环境光照、加载器和场景交互等重复工程化需求封装成组件。
strength.en: Packages reusable controls, environment helpers, asset loaders and scene interactions.

learning.zh: 研究哪些组件能加快产品展示开发，哪些高频更新需直接 Three.js 控制。
learning.en: Evaluate which helpers accelerate product viewers and which high-frequency paths need direct Three.js.

projects.name: Theatre.js
projects.upstream_license: Apache-2.0 public repository; 1.0 development disclosed in private

summary.zh: 支持可视化时间轴和程序化控制的网页精密动画编排工具。
summary.en: A timeline-based animation toolkit for detailed motion design and programmatic control.

strength.zh: 把镜头位置、关键帧和微交互作为可编辑数据，而不仅是脚本里散落的 Tween。
strength.en: Turns camera paths, keyframes and micro-interactions into editable data rather than scattered tweens.

learning.zh: 用一段原创 3D 产品分镜验证关键帧与用户拖动的正确交互；关注公开版本滞后说明。
learning.en: Prototype an original product shot with keyframes plus user scrubbing, noting the public release lag.

projects.name: Threlte
projects.upstream_license: Check upstream project license

summary.zh: 为 Svelte 应用提供声明式 Three.js 场景集成。
summary.en: A declarative Three.js integration for Svelte applications.

strength.zh: 利用 Svelte 的响应式状态与组件结构搭建 3D 页面，适合非 React 项目。
strength.en: Uses Svelte reactivity and components for 3D pages without requiring React.

learning.zh: 比较同一场景在 Threlte 和原生 Three.js 中的更新、资源释放与渲染开销。
learning.en: Compare update cycles, disposal and rendering cost against vanilla Three.js.

projects.name: TresJS
projects.upstream_license: Check upstream project license

summary.zh: 面向 Vue 的声明式 Three.js 生态，便于在 Vue 网站中组合三维组件。
summary.en: A declarative Three.js ecosystem for integrating scenes into Vue applications.

strength.zh: 将 Vue 响应式状态和图形实体组合，为普通业务页面添加可控 3D 内容。
strength.en: Combines Vue reactivity with graphic entities to add interactive 3D into conventional apps.

learning.zh: 对照同一 GLB 商品页在 Vue/TresJS 与 Three.js 的交互延迟及内存使用。
learning.en: Compare input latency and memory for the same GLB viewer across Vue/TresJS and native Three.js.

projects.name: OGL
projects.upstream_license: Check upstream license

summary.zh: 轻量级 WebGL 渲染库，适合自定义 Shader 和高控制力的交互视觉项目。
summary.en: A lightweight WebGL library oriented toward custom shaders and controlled visual experiences.

strength.zh: 抽象层较薄，便于在视觉实验中直接管理着色器和缓冲区。
strength.en: A relatively thin abstraction gives visual experiments direct control over shaders and buffers.

learning.zh: 学习渲染基础和 GPU 数据组织，再评估其与大型游戏引擎的职责边界。
learning.en: Learn render fundamentals and GPU data layout, while assessing the boundary with full engines.

projects.name: regl
projects.upstream_license: Check upstream license

summary.zh: 以声明式命令组织 WebGL draw calls 的函数式渲染工具。
summary.en: A functional WebGL toolkit organized around declarative draw commands.

strength.zh: 将 WebGL 状态与绘制命令组合为可复用的调用结构。
strength.en: Packages WebGL state and draw commands into reusable invocation units.

learning.zh: 研究 draw command、状态管理及直接 WebGL 与 Three.js 的性能差异。
learning.en: Study draw commands, state management and performance versus raw WebGL or Three.js.

projects.name: cannon-es
projects.upstream_license: Check upstream LICENSE

summary.zh: JavaScript/TypeScript 生态的 3D 刚体物理与碰撞引擎。
summary.en: A JavaScript/TypeScript 3D rigid-body physics engine.

strength.zh: 提供轻量的浏览器物理选择，便于对照 Rapier 的集成成本与计算性能。
strength.en: Offers a comparatively lightweight browser-physics choice for benchmarking against Rapier.

learning.zh: 在同一场景比较固定步长、刚体堆叠稳定性与碰撞开销。
learning.en: Compare fixed-step stacking stability and collision cost with another engine.

projects.name: Spector.js
projects.upstream_license: Check current upstream LICENSE

summary.zh: 浏览器 WebGL 帧捕获与 GPU 绘制命令调试工具。
summary.en: A WebGL frame capture and graphics debugging tool for the browser.

strength.zh: 把复杂帧的 shader、纹理、状态和 draw calls 拆开分析，定位黑屏与性能热点。
strength.en: Inspects shaders, textures, state and draw calls to diagnose black frames and GPU bottlenecks.

learning.zh: 对我们游戏的黑幕、材质状态错误和多余 Draw Call 做真实帧捕获分析。
learning.en: Capture real frames to investigate black geometry, incorrect materials and redundant draw calls.

projects.name: Khronos glTF Sample Viewer
projects.upstream_license: Check current repository license and asset-by-asset rights

summary.zh: Khronos 官方 glTF 2.0 参考查看器，用于验证 PBR 材质和扩展支持。
summary.en: The Khronos reference glTF 2.0 viewer for evaluating PBR materials and extensions.

strength.zh: 提供独立于我们渲染器的模型对照基线，帮助区分资产缺陷和引擎缺陷。
strength.en: Provides a renderer-independent asset baseline to distinguish model defects from engine bugs.

learning.zh: 用同一 GLB 对照官方 Viewer、Three.js、Godot 的外观与动画差异。
learning.en: Compare a GLB's materials and animation in the reference viewer, Three.js and Godot.

projects.name: Khronos glTF Validator
projects.upstream_license: Apache-2.0

summary.zh: 按 glTF 2.0 标准检查 GLB/glTF 结构、材质、动画及扩展的官方验证工具。
summary.en: The official validator for glTF 2.0 structures, buffers, animations, images and extensions.

strength.zh: 给出机器可读的 JSON 问题报告，能把资产发布从肉眼挑错升级成自动校验。
strength.en: Produces machine-readable JSON reports that turn asset compliance into an automated release check.

learning.zh: 把 Validator 加入资产工厂，结合可视对照和碰撞检查而非把语法通过当视觉合格。
learning.en: Integrate validation into asset QA alongside visual comparison and collision tests.

projects.name: Khronos glTF Sample Models
projects.upstream_license: Per-model licenses vary; do not assume blanket reuse

summary.zh: Khronos 维护的 glTF 示例模型集合，覆盖多种材质、动画与扩展测试场景。
summary.en: A curated collection of glTF sample assets spanning materials, animation and extensions.

strength.zh: 提供具备明确参考预期的模型，用于发现不同引擎间 PBR 与格式兼容差异。
strength.en: Supplies reference assets for testing PBR and compatibility across rendering engines.

learning.zh: 逐模型核对授权，挑选允许的样本构建多引擎外观回归测试。
learning.en: Audit each model's license before using it in cross-engine visual regression tests.

projects.name: Google Draco
projects.upstream_license: Apache-2.0

summary.zh: Google 开源的 3D 网格与点云几何压缩库。
summary.en: Google's open-source geometry compression for 3D meshes and point clouds.

strength.zh: 大幅压缩可传输几何数据，代价是解码时间与运行端处理开销。
strength.en: Reduces geometry payload size at the cost of decoding work.

learning.zh: 测 Draco 与 Meshopt 在同一 GLB 上的文件大小、解码耗时和设备兼容。
learning.en: Compare Draco and Meshopt on the same GLB for size, decode time and compatibility.

projects.name: Basis Universal
projects.upstream_license: Check current upstream LICENSE; texture source rights separate

summary.zh: 面向 GPU 纹理的超压缩与多平台转码工具。
summary.en: A supercompressed texture codec and transcoding toolkit for GPU delivery.

strength.zh: 一次存储即可按目标设备转码为不同的 GPU 纹理格式，有利于减小带宽和显存占用。
strength.en: Stores compressed textures once and transcodes for platform GPU formats to improve delivery.

learning.zh: 比较 KTX2/Basis 和原始 PNG 的画质、带宽、启动耗时及显存表现。
learning.en: Benchmark KTX2/Basis against PNG for quality, bandwidth, startup time and GPU memory.

projects.name: stats.js
projects.upstream_license: MIT

summary.zh: 极简的浏览器 FPS、帧时间与内存实时监测面板。
summary.en: A compact browser panel displaying FPS, frame time and memory metrics.

strength.zh: 不隐藏真实性能状态，快速监测过度 Shader、分辨率和循环开销。
strength.en: Exposes basic real-time performance signals for expensive shaders, resolution and loops.

learning.zh: 将轻量监控接入开发场景，并用浏览器 Performance 工具交叉验证。
learning.en: Embed basic monitoring in development scenes and cross-check with browser profiling.

projects.name: three-gpu-pathtracer
projects.upstream_license: Check current upstream LICENSE

summary.zh: 结合 Three.js、BVH 和 GPU 计算着色器的渐进式物理路径追踪项目。
summary.en: A progressive physically based path tracer combining Three.js, BVH and GPU compute shaders.

strength.zh: 在浏览器内实现具有真实反射、折射、焦外与光源采样的高品质渲染。
strength.en: Renders physically plausible reflections, refraction, depth of field and sampled lighting in-browser.

learning.zh: 用于材质对照和商品静帧，不把重型路径追踪作为所有实时游戏场景的默认方案。
learning.en: Use it for material baselines and product stills, not as the default for every real-time game.

projects.name: PlayCanvas Web Components
projects.upstream_license: MIT repository; editor/hosted services separate

summary.zh: 通过自定义 HTML 元素创建和配置 PlayCanvas 三维场景的组件方案。
summary.en: A set of HTML custom elements for constructing and configuring PlayCanvas scenes.

strength.zh: 将一些 3D 场景配置转化成声明式标记，降低产品网页整合门槛。
strength.en: Expresses common scene configuration in declarative HTML, simplifying product-site integration.

learning.zh: 研究静态网页中的 3D 初始化、可访问性和资源加载边界。
learning.en: Study 3D initialization, accessibility and asset loading in conventional pages.

projects.name: Aten7 — Toom Archives
projects.upstream_license: Original site/brand assets proprietary; case-study analysis only

summary.zh: Immersive Garden 创作的科幻 WebGL 世界，融合动态季节、粒子和可探索的未来遗迹。
summary.en: A sci-fi WebGL world by Immersive Garden with changing seasons, particles and explorable future architecture.

strength.zh: 叙事系统与环境天气、视觉符号实时同步，让场景本身承担剧情传达。
strength.en: Narrative, environmental weather and visual symbols evolve together so the world carries the story.

learning.zh: 学习同一建筑在天气、季节和视觉阶段变化时的资产组织方式，不能臆测源码 Shader。
learning.en: Study how one environment supports weather, seasons and story beats without inventing undocumented shader internals.

projects.name: Cartier in Time
projects.upstream_license: Cartier video/branding and creator work remain proprietary

summary.zh: 围绕十二小时、十二部短片设计的沉浸式品牌交互叙事。
summary.en: An immersive brand story structured as twelve hours and twelve cinematic shorts.

strength.zh: 用钟表时针作为导航隐喻，形成独特的时间轮播与镜头转场。
strength.en: Uses a clock-hand metaphor as navigation for an unusual time-based carousel and cinematic transitions.

learning.zh: 学习把产品隐喻转译成时间轴交互，重点研究镜头节奏而非复制品牌素材。
learning.en: Study translating a product metaphor into timeline navigation; learn pacing without copying brand assets.

projects.name: ITom Sketch Portfolio
projects.upstream_license: Creator portfolio proprietary; no source reuse implied

summary.zh: 以手绘纹理三维走廊取代普通网页滚动的互动作品集。
summary.en: An interactive portfolio using a hand-drawn 3D corridor instead of conventional scrolling.

strength.zh: 官方项目介绍披露 React、Three.js 与 GSAP 的组合，以及进入不同房间的导航形式。
strength.en: The creator describes React, Three.js and GSAP driving room-by-room navigation and illustrated textures.

learning.zh: 研究三维走廊中的入口、返回、镜头位移、纹理过渡和触控可用性。
learning.en: Study doors, transitions, camera travel, navigation recovery and touch accessibility.

projects.name: Immersive Garden — Studio Works
projects.upstream_license: Agency work and client assets proprietary

summary.zh: 创意技术工作室的沉浸式 WebGL 网站案例库，涵盖奢侈品牌、科幻叙事和数字展览。
summary.en: A studio portfolio of immersive WebGL experiences spanning luxury brands, sci-fi worlds and digital exhibitions.

strength.zh: 多个不同行业案例展示如何围绕单一品牌想法设计互动节奏，而不是堆特效。
strength.en: Shows how interactive pacing can grow from a brand idea instead of stacking effects indiscriminately.

learning.zh: 逐案例追溯制作方原始文章、可访问项目和已披露技术，不把整个作品集当开源素材。
learning.en: Trace original creator case studies, live experiences and documented techniques case by case.

projects.name: Active Theory — Studio Experiences
projects.upstream_license: Client projects and studio technology proprietary

summary.zh: 专注大型交互式品牌活动与实时 Web 3D 的创意技术工作室。
summary.en: A creative technology studio known for large-scale interactive brand campaigns and real-time web experiences.

strength.zh: 用具有游戏引擎特性的交互逻辑组织营销网站，兼顾大场景叙事。
strength.en: Applies game-like interaction logic to complex web narratives and large spatial experiences.

learning.zh: 研究进度保存、输入反馈和复杂网站的运行时组织，具体技术栈逐项目核实。
learning.en: Study progress, input feedback and runtime organization; verify each project's stack separately.

projects.name: Spline — Interactive 3D Editor
projects.upstream_license: Proprietary hosted product; pricing and export rights vary by plan

summary.zh: 可在浏览器协作制作实时三维内容的编辑器，支持交互、状态、动画、导出及 MCP 接入。
summary.en: A collaborative browser editor for interactive 3D with states, animation, exports and MCP-based agent workflows.

strength.zh: 把建模、状态事件与可嵌入网页的交互结果保留在同一个可编辑工程里。
strength.en: Keeps modeling, event states and publishable interactions within the same editable project.

learning.zh: 研究其基于对象的 MCP 编辑与原生 WebGPU/WebGL 输出模型；审查导出和商业条款。
learning.en: Study object-level MCP editing and WebGPU/WebGL runtime delivery while reviewing export and commercial terms.

projects.name: React Three Rapier
projects.upstream_license: MIT (wrapper code); visual assets and integration terms separate

summary.zh: 把 Rapier WASM 刚体物理接入 React Three Fiber 的可复用组件库。
summary.en: A React Three Fiber integration for WASM-based Rapier rigid-body physics.

strength.zh: 通过明确的刚体、碰撞器、关节、传感器与事件接口，为浏览器三维世界建立可信的接触和空间行为。
strength.en: Exposes rigid bodies, colliders, joints, sensors and collision events to make spatial behavior testable in browser 3D.

learning.zh: 研究物理固定步长与渲染插值、视觉网格和碰撞体分离、车轮接地以及人物与场景的碰撞；不把物理库当成现成车辆模拟。
learning.en: Study fixed simulation steps, interpolated rendering, distinct render/collision meshes and wheel or avatar contacts; do not mistake the library for a complete vehicle model.

projects.name: W3C Immersive Web — WebXR Samples
projects.upstream_license: MIT (software); external media and device datasets require separate review

summary.zh: 由 Immersive Web 工作社区维护的 WebXR API 示例，覆盖 VR、AR、控制器与空间交互。
summary.en: Immersive Web community examples covering WebXR VR, AR, controllers and spatial interaction APIs.

strength.zh: 将会话、参考坐标系、锚点、命中测试、手部输入、传送和空间音频拆成可阅读、可独立验证的示例。
strength.en: Separates sessions, reference spaces, anchors, hit tests, hand input, teleportation and spatial audio into readable test cases.

learning.zh: 学习按设备与会话模式探测能力、统一输入抽象和XR降级；不能从WebGPU支持推断WebGPU-XR支持。
learning.en: Learn device- and session-specific feature detection, portable input abstraction and graceful fallback; WebGPU alone does not establish WebGPU-XR support.

projects.name: Tiny Delivery — Sinica
projects.upstream_license: Commercial game and Unity Asset Store environment art; no license to copy game's assets or scenes

summary.zh: 以六轮送货机器人探索绿意浓郁的小镇与林地，具有柔和、绘画般的风格化三维美术。
summary.en: A delivery-robot adventure through lush small towns and forests, with softly illustrated stylized 3D environments.

strength.zh: 开发者公开拆解了从参考图、草地纹理与植被套件到水岸、苔藓、自然散布及柔和光照的完整氛围制作过程。
strength.en: The developer documents the atmosphere-building process from visual references and grass material matching to foliage, shores, moss, natural scattering and lighting.

learning.zh: 优先研究叶片和草地的风格一致性、植被生态聚集及镜头，不把作者的 Unity 方案误称为水彩 Shader 或开源游戏。
learning.en: Prioritize consistency of leaf and grass artwork, ecological clustering and composition; do not mislabel this Unity game as an open-source watercolor shader.

projects.name: Dordogne — Hand-painted Watercolor 3D
projects.upstream_license: Proprietary game and original watercolor artwork; no reproduction rights

summary.zh: 以真实纸本水彩画投射到三维场景上的叙事探索游戏，呈现直接进入画中世界的氛围。
summary.en: A narrative exploration game projecting traditional watercolor artworks onto three-dimensional spaces.

strength.zh: 美术总监解释使用 Camera Mapping 把手绘水彩投向简化模型，画中的光影主要由画作本身承担。
strength.en: The art director describes camera mapping original painted scenes onto simplified 3D geometry, preserving painterly lighting and shadows.

learning.zh: 研究传统绘画与三维空间的结合，适用于固定或半固定镜头；自由旋转视角则需多方向补画或真正的三维材质。
learning.en: Study authentic painting projected into 3D for controlled camera views; freely rotating scenes require additional view artwork or fully textured geometry.

projects.name: Tiny Glade — Painterly Vegetation
projects.upstream_license: Commercial game; source, models and grass renderer not open for reuse

summary.zh: 温暖精致的可互动微缩建筑与花草世界，官方持续公开草地、花卉、体积雾等技术更新。
summary.en: A cozy miniature building world with interactive plants, flowers and atmospheric rendering discussed in official technical updates.

strength.zh: 2026年官方说明新草地生成与绘制架构借鉴 Nanite Foliage 理念，让密集花草与远景柔软感同时可控。
strength.en: The studio reports a 2026 redesign of grass authoring/rendering inspired by Nanite Foliage ideas, allowing richer meadow plants and softer distant grass.

learning.zh: 学习植物品种化、画笔式增密、层次和地面雾气的共同作用；官方并未开源其植被渲染器。
learning.en: Study botanical variety, brush-based density editing, atmospheric fog and layered greenery; the proprietary implementation is not released as open source.

projects.name: Cozy Cottage — Kayla Kosik Art Breakdown
projects.upstream_license: Artist's original scene and concept/third-party art proprietary; tutorial may be read, not copied wholesale

summary.zh: 专业环境美术师的吉卜力感小屋场景制作拆解，重点展示手绘植物图集与场景美术编排。
summary.en: A professional environment artist's painterly cottage breakdown centered on handcrafted botanical texture atlases and composition.

strength.zh: 明确展示手绘 Albedo+透明度图集、按叶片外轮廓裁切网格、植物枢轴和手绘天空与纹理分工。
strength.en: Documents hand-painted albedo+alpha foliage atlases, silhouette-cut plant geometry with rooted pivots, and painted sky/texture planning.

learning.zh: 先画植物、再映射到三维卡片并人工调整形态，严禁用统一绿色球体取代复杂自然叶簇。
learning.en: Paint species first, then map and shape them into layered 3D cards; do not replace botanical forms with generic green primitive masses.

projects.name: Just a Simple Tree — Mike Fernandez
projects.upstream_license: MIT source code; separately credited music, sound and demo media require their own rights review

summary.zh: 基于 Three.js WebGPU/TSL 的六树种可参数化绘画风树木工厂，支持生长、季节、动态树叶与 GLB 导出。
summary.en: A browser-based Three.js/WebGPU anime tree studio with six species, seasons, growth, animated foliage and GLB export.

strength.zh: 把真实分枝、树叶透明纹理卡、叶簇共享法线、内部 AO、颜色带和分层风动结合，形成可信树冠。
strength.en: Combines branching silhouettes, painted leaf cards, clump-inherited normals, internal occlusion, color bands and independent multi-scale wind.

learning.zh: 重点研读 foliage.js、wood.js、shading.js、wind.js 与导出流程；柔和水彩氛围需要替换硬边赛璐璐光色。
learning.en: Study foliage.js, wood.js, shading.js, wind.js and exports; soften the original cel bands when targeting a watercolor-like look.

projects.name: Three.js Field Grass — Painterly Wind
projects.upstream_license: MIT core library; demo character, animation and media have separate licenses; experimental 0.1.0 release

summary.zh: 可用于 Three.js 游戏的互动草地工程，包含多叶簇、定向草浪、动态风场和实体经过后的恢复轨迹。
summary.en: An experimental Three.js grass system with multi-blade tufts, directional wind and settling interaction wakes.

strength.zh: 公开 TSL 着色器、WebGPU/WebGL2 路径、确定性散布与草浪形变，支持海量草叶的统一材料绘制。
strength.en: Provides TSL materials with WebGPU/WebGL2 support, deterministic scatter and bounded deformation fields for dense grass.

learning.zh: 作为草地动态与地形融合的技术底座，必须先补原创手绘植被材质；注意库要求 Three.js 0.185.x。
learning.en: Study motion and terrain integration but supply original botanical art; its pinned Three.js 0.185.x dependency requires careful integration.

projects.name: Yomotsu Vegetation — Procedural Nature Kit
projects.upstream_license: MIT repository; separately introduced third-party textures/models require independent rights checks

summary.zh: 基于 Three.js 的开源程序化植物与自然物件库，包括树木、石头、卵石、草花与苔藓覆盖。
summary.en: An open Three.js vegetation toolkit generating trees, rocks, pebbles, grass, flowers and optional moss.

strength.zh: 提供种子化可重建资产、五级 LOD、异步 Web Worker 生成、部分碰撞网格，以及 WebGPU/WebGL 双兼容。
strength.en: Includes reproducible seeded geometry, five LOD stages, Web Worker generation, solid-object colliders and WebGPU/WebGL compatibility.

learning.zh: 吸收种类化的植物与石块程序、苔藓和真实米制接口；最终叶片和花朵仍需美术师定义材质与外形。
learning.en: Learn botanical type systems, rock/moss layering and meter-scale APIs; commissioned or authored leaf/flower art must determine the final look.

projects.name: Wildward — Co-op Wilderness Expedition
projects.upstream_license: Indie game promotional clips; no source or reuse license verified; do not conflate @PlayWildward with the unrelated-seeming medieval fantasy website

summary.zh: 2026年11月公开展示的一至四人合作荒野探险项目，视频展示越野车、程序化草地、森林与河流环境。
summary.en: A newly announced 1–4 player cooperative wilderness expedition with Jeep driving, procedural grass and simulated rivers.

strength.zh: 原账号多段视频将车身重量感、地面起伏、植被形变、水面涉水与有氛围的远近景组合成连续的探索镜头。
strength.en: The creator's clips combine terrain-reactive Jeep driving, grass contact, water splashes and coherent near-to-far environment composition.

learning.zh: 研究车轮接触/悬架、植被动态形变、可模拟河流水面以及高度场地形；所有具体引擎与源码实现暂未确认。
learning.en: Study wheel contact and suspension, deformable grass, simulated water and terrain cohesion; specific engine and source remain unverified.

projects.name: Evan Wallace — WebGL Water
projects.upstream_license: MIT notice in repository index.html; third-party tile texture, cubemaps and other visual assets have separate rights

summary.zh: 经典浏览器交互水体技术实验，以二维高度场和 GPU 波浪模拟呈现反射、折射及焦散。
summary.en: A foundational browser water experiment using GPU heightfield waves, reflections, refractions and caustics.

strength.zh: 用户可直接扰动水面或移动浸水球体，原始代码公开，便于研究水面状态与光学着色如何分离。
strength.en: Public source allows direct study of interactive water disturbances, moving objects and separate wave/optical shading.

learning.zh: 学习高度速度双场、交互冲量和 Fresnel/焦散；泳池范例不能直接当成真实流动河流。
learning.en: Learn height/velocity fields, impulses, Fresnel optics and caustics; a pool demo is not automatically a flowing river.

projects.name: Jean Timex (Su) — WebGPU Water
projects.upstream_license: MIT code verified in LICENSE; underlying demo textures and media require independent attribution

summary.zh: Evan Wallace 水体技术的 WebGPU 实现，包含 GPU 高度场、实时焦散和浮体交互。
summary.en: A WebGPU port of the classic interactive water simulation with heightfield waves, caustics and a buoyant object.

strength.zh: 公开以256×256 网格计算水位波动、以1024×1024 纹理渲染焦散并组合光学反射和折射。
strength.en: Documents 256×256 wave field, 1024×1024 caustics, Fresnel reflection/refraction and interactive buoyancy.

learning.zh: 先验证水波、焦散和浸水物体的统一状态，再实现河流边界、流向、轮胎涉水与泡沫。
learning.en: Verify coherent waves, optics and object interaction before adapting to rivers, current fields and tire splashes.

projects.name: SweK — Single-file WebGL2 Water
projects.upstream_license: MIT code verified in LICENSE; source-independent artwork and input assets must be checked separately

summary.zh: 零构建依赖的单 HTML 文件 WebGL2 水体模拟，展示浮点纹理乒乓更新、波浪、Fresnel 和焦散。
summary.en: A standalone single-HTML WebGL2 GPU water demo with ping-pong heightfield waves, Fresnel and caustics.

strength.zh: 将高度场、差分面积焦散和光学混合集中于可阅读的单文件示例，便于最小复现与测试。
strength.en: A compact, inspectable implementation of float-texture heightfields, differential-area caustics and optical blending.

learning.zh: 作为 WebGL2 水体兼容基线；不要把画面波纹直接等同于真实河流流体求解或车辆浮力。
learning.en: Use as a reproducible WebGL2 baseline, not as proof of full flowing-water or vehicle-buoyancy physics.
